scheme_name: PLI Scheme for White Goods (AC & LED)
overview: The PLI Scheme for White Goods (AC & LED) targets manufacturers of components/sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights and offers 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.
target_beneficiaries: manufacturers of components/sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights
objectives: Build a domestic supply chain for AC and LED components
eligibility: Manufacturers of components/sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights are eligible under the PLI Scheme for White Goods.
benefits: The scheme offers 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.
financial_support: The scheme offers 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
